svg.title: AIcoach upload page and analysing state, Lab Instrument concept
svg.text: One swing, filmed down the line. The analysis reads it frame by frame.
mp4 or mov · up to 15 seconds · one swing · down the line
Longer clips or other formats are refused before analysis.
View, framing and swing count are checked during analysis. If they fail, you get “Cannot analyse” with reasons.

text.tspan: If you switch this on, the video is stored on the AIcoach server until you delete it.
Left off, the clip is deleted as soon as the analysis is finished. The result is kept either way.
